summary: Let riders take a third bike for group rides
description: A group of riders on a team outing asked whether one person could check out a third bike to carry a friend's bag and jacket for the ride. Support wants to know if we should relax the per-rider bike limit for cases like this.

comments.author: dana.whitlock
comments.body: Curious what fleet thinks -- is there an operational reason to keep it tight, or is this just how the check-out flow happened to be built?

comments.author: priya.lund
comments.body: Declining this one. The cap stays at 2 bikes per rider -- try to check out a third and the system already refuses it -- because letting one rider walk off with three bikes makes it too easy to starve a station.
